I can't tell if this is exactly the same as goop's previous G.Tox malachite cleanser but it looks and smells exactly the same. It lathers beautifully and makes my skin feel clean without being stripped. The bottle is plastic which I get because glass isn't good in the shower but I still don't want microplastics in my skincare.
I use this in the morning and night, it has a really light texture and the scent is very nice. My skin feels really clean afterwards! Will repurchase!
The product feels so luxurious on my face! This is a quality product for a great price. Highly recommend, zero regrets.

avis.titre: Finally a cleanser that's simpatico with my skin
avis.texte: Love this cleanser! I have roseacea and am always hesitant about trying new cleansers as they tend to be too harsh. This cleanser is gentle but removes dirt, grime and makeup without leaving my skin dry. The pump dispenses the perfect amount of product, and combined with a little water on my face, creates a silky soapy texture for massaging into the skin. It rinses off easily and smells lovely. I will continue to use this cleanser.

A little goes a long way! Instantly foaming and gives a very light fragrance that leaves the face feeling squeaky clean and fresh. It makes my face feel better (brighter/refreshed). It can make the T zone dry, so I moisturize immediately after using it.
I love how this makes my skin feel. Clean but not stripped. The herbaceous smell is heavenly. The foaming is beyond heavenly.

avis.titre: Love, love, love!  This will be my go to cleanser!
avis.texte: I love this cleaner. So glad it came out! It lathers nicely and cleans well. Has a light fresh fragrance. It's an awesome product!

I am so impressed by this cleanser. It has the PERFECT foam, smells so fresh and clean, and cleans my skin beautifully while not stripping it or making it dry. Also takes off make up! I really really love it for everyday.

Guys.... this cleanser is amazing! It cleans off all of my makeup in one cleanse and EXTRA perk it looks fantastic in my shower. Also, the scent is fantastic! I'm not even sure what the scent is.... mint, eucalyptus maybe? Whatever it is, it's just great!

I love this face cleanser – it rinses easily, leaves skin feeling super clean, yet not dry, and without any oily or creamy residue. A great improvement from the previous iteration of this cleanser, which was too harsh!
Love this wonderful foaming cleanser on my face and face! Very refreshing!
So happy I tried it! I really like it. I have added it to my collection of washes.
Excellent everyday cleanser. Clears away makeup, spf and dirt without leaving skin dry!
Daily detox takes very little time commitment, but great determination. My skin responding well to the regimen with toner, exfoliant and moisturizer.
Love Love Love this new cleanser. Smells so fresh. Cleans very well Skin isn't stripped but feels very soft after.Rich foam but rinses completely.
Light, fresh, foamy wash that cleans my skin without stripping it. Leaves my face feeling soft and clean. Love it!

I LOVE this cleanser! I have been using it for about 2 weeks now, 1x per day and feel like it's been the missing part of my daily routine. Skin feels clean, fresh and soft. I am normally skeptical about foaming cleansers and never write reviews, but the goop team nailed this product.
I'm so glad they brought this cleanser back! It's foamy in the best way, doesn't dry my skin out yet leaves it feeling so clean and fresh!
Cleans my face with zero stripping. Lovely scent. My favorite new cleanser. Love everything about it. My skin feels clean and soft.

This is the best daily cleaner. I can feel it working below the surface. Leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh but not dry. I use it after removing makeup with Goop Cleansing Balm or Haruharu Wonder Black Rice Moisture Cleansing Oi.
Feels good, smells good, easy on the eyes. Convenient pump size.
The chemists nailed it with this product and the formulation is perfect. Refreshing, removes all the gunk of the day, and soothing on sensitive skin.

My second favorite skin care product (First is the microderm exfoliator)! I love the way my skin feels after using it. I have very oily, acne prone skin and this works well with my skin. It is not too harsh and does not cause breakouts.
